title: Due-date schedule
intro: Track installments and known balances in the period.
scope: Supplier documents for this device, company and store. This is not the entire financial position and excludes unknown external payments.
asOfHelp: The reference date classifies due dates. Payments and balances are current at query time, not historical balances on that date.
sourceHelp: Source: server CSV schedule version 2. Metrics are checked against installments without adding summary and details twice.
sheetHelp: Sending to sheets copies the queried data without an automatic link. Money remains in integer cents, as shown in column titles. Up to 500 installments per transfer.
range: Choose valid ordered dates spanning no more than 366 inclusive days.
format: The server returned an incomplete, incompatible or inconsistent schedule. No totals were displayed.
sheetLimit: Select up to 500 installments to send to sheets.
stale: Dates changed. Query the period to update results and enable export.
metricsScope: Metrics cover the full queried period. Filters below affect only rows and filtered export.
openOnly: Only approved installments with a balance
noSheets: Sending to sheets requires the role and finance-source access allowed by the sheets module.
documentNotLoaded: The document is not among those loaded. Refresh documents or check the server record.
